title: Workshop attitude for solar shield deployment
body: Following micrometeoroid shield loss on launch (1973-05-14), workshop shall be biased to a high-pitch attitude during repair EVAs to reduce thermal load on the workshop skin. Solar parasol must remain deployed; A-frame shield secondary.

title: LM descent abort from PDI to lunar contact
body: If the LM Descent Engine throttling fails or the AGS / PGNS disagrees on descent profile by > 10 m/s vertical or > 5 deg attitude, abort to lunar orbit. Use AGS abort guidance if PGNS indicted.

title: Lunar Module rendezvous abort from CSM
body: If LM fails to ascend or rendezvous, the CSM shall remain in lunar orbit until LM final-stage abort is verified or LM crew is recovered. CSM crew shall not return without LM unless LM crew is confirmed lost.

title: LM-as-lifeboat power configuration
body: If CSM fuel cells degrade below 1.5 kW total: 1. Power down all CSM systems except VHF voice and one S-band omni. 2. Crew transfers to LM with portable life support. 3. LM batteries operate single-string with timeline budgeted for re-entry. 4. CSM cold-soak managed via slow-roll (PTC).
citation: Apollo 13 Crew Procedures MSC-04112; Mission Report §5.3

title: Cryo tank no-stir window
body: Following the Apollo 13 anomaly, cryo-stir commands are prohibited in the 2-hour window before any major ΔV burn. If pressure drift > 2 psi/hr is observed without stir, ground evaluates tank state via redundant sensors before authorising any stir.

title: Data Storage Equipment loss-of-data
body: If the DSE recorder fails to play back, ground shall request crew to use Hi-Bit-Rate playback via the unified S-band system. Crew shall not over-write existing tape until ground confirms playback success.
